2608.10986.title: What Iterated Self-Feeding Probes of Language Models Measure, and a test that separates the construction from the model
2608.10986.paper_summary: A growing class of methods probes a language model by feeding it its own output: self-consistency, iterated refinement, agentic loops. We ask what such a probe measures, in a construction chosen to make the question sharp: a ring of token cells resampled in place by the model's own windowed conditional p_r(x_i | x_{i+-r}). The substrate is Glauber dynamics on token sequences and is not new; what we change is the coupling. Advancing two rings that differ in one token under common random numbers makes undamaged copies diverge by exactly zero, so damage spreading becomes measurable where a maximal coupling gives mixing times instead. The answer is that it measures two different things at once, in readings that look alike. Some quantities are fixed by the construction: the damage light cone is kinematic, and the radius scaling of the token-space Lyapunov exponent lambda_ca(r) is model-invariant across 19 models and two scale ladders spanning 70x. Others genuinely track the model: lambda_ca crosses zero at a reproducible point in training, and the attractor share ranks models consistently however the lattice is built. Left undistinguished, the first kind is readily mistaken for the second -- we did so ourselves for four months, and report a phase transition we measured to three decimal places that belongs to the probe rather than to any language model. We give the test that separates them: hold the construction fixed and vary the model, or hold the model fixed and vary the construction, and see which readings move. We validate the instrument by reproduction first, recovering a Domany-Kinzel damage field bit-exactly against an independent prediction, and we report the estimator failures that this discipline caught -- four retracted verdicts, each on a quantity that looked like a measurement. The methodology ships as a package.
2608.10986.paper_summary_zh: 一類日益增長的方法通過將自身輸出餵入語言模型來探測模型：自我一致性、迭代精煉、代理循環。我們詢問這樣的探測測量了什麼，使用一個選擇的構造來使問題清晰：一個由模型自身的窗口條件 p_r(x_i | x_{i+-r}) 重新取樣的標記單元環。基底是標記序列上的 Glauber 動力學，這並不新穎；我們改變的是耦合。推進兩個在一個標記上不同的環，使用共同的隨機數，使未受損的副本完全不變，因此損傷擴散在最大耦合提供混合時間的地方變得可測量。答案是它同時測量兩種不同的事物，在看起來相似的讀數中。一些量由構造固定：損傷光錐是運動學的，而標記空間的 Lyapunov 指數 lambda_ca(r) 的半徑縮放在 19 個模型和跨越 70 倍的兩個尺度梯子中是模型不變的。其他則真實地跟踪模型：lambda_ca 在訓練中的可重現點交叉零，並且吸引子份額在無論晶格如何構建的情況下都一致地對模型進行排名。如果不加區分，第一種很容易被誤認為第二種——我們自己在四個月內就是這樣做的，並報告了一個我們測量到小數點後三位的相變，這屬於探測而非任何語言模型。我們給出了區分它們的測試：保持構造固定並改變模型，或者保持模型固定並改變構造，看看哪些讀數會變動。我們首先通過重現來驗證儀器，準確恢復一個 Domany-Kinzel 損傷場，與獨立預測完全一致，並報告這一學科捕捉到的估計器失敗——四個撤回的裁決，每一個都是關於看似測量的量。該方法論作為一個包裝發送。
2608.10986.author: Nicolás Vera Zúñiga et.al.
